channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Serge Ibaka | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Serge Ibaka from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Brook Lopez, Serge Ibaka, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis
item.description:
“When a guy’s driving, you don’t want to over-help or shift all the way. You kind of trust that either the guy guarding the ball is going to guard his guy straight upor it’s going to be Brook (Lopez), Giannis (Antetokounmpo), Bobby (Portis), Serge (Ibaka), one of the bigger guys coming over. “And then the guards are more staying home and either trying to completely limit the pass or if they do get the pass off, just be there, so they can’t get the shot off. It’s slightly different with our habits off the ball, so it’s not a huge change.”

Grayson Allen on Brook Lopez, Serge Ibaka, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis, Oct 4, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Moussa Diabate on Tim Thomas, Kevin Garnett, Serge Ibaka, Pascal Siakam, Bam Adebayo, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Moussa Diabaté:

“Over the years, I’ll say a lot of Bam Adebayo, Pascal Siakam, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Kevin Garnett. Those are four players that I’ve really looked up to. I watch a little bit of everyone. Tim Thomas, I don’t know if you know him, but I watch a little bit of him. Serge Ibaka, I watch him from back when he was in OKC; that’s another big one. Just players like that – all-around big 4s and centers who are able to move their feet, guard on the perimeter, be versatile and make a two-way impact.”

Moussa Diabate on Tim Thomas, Kevin Garnett, Serge Ibaka, Pascal Siakam, Bam Adebayo, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 9, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey
item.description:
“Josh Giddey is great. Sam Presti, I don’t understand this guy’s eye for talent. He drafted KD, Russ [Westbrook], Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey and the list goes on and on and on. This guy is pretty damn good.”

LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey, Feb 20, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on Serge Ibaka:

“Not sure how soon, I know he's progressing really well... when they all say he's ready to go, then he'll be able to play.”

Tyronn Lue on Serge Ibaka, Oct 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Lawrence Frank on Serge Ibaka's rehab:

“He has a maniacal work ethic ... he's made terrific progress. He'll start out in training camp doing non contact and we'll access his progress and where he's going once we introduce contact at a certain point ... see how he responds to it.”

Lawrence Frank on Serge Ibaka, Sep 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Rick Barry on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Golden State legend Rick Barry likes the idea of the eight-time NBA All-Star joining Golden State, but there is a certain pending free agent the Hall of Famer wants to see in a Warriors uniform next season.

“The guy that I'd like to see them get -- it would be unbelievable -- I love Serge Ibaka,”

Rick Barry on Serge Ibaka, Oct 18, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Marc Gasol:

“I'm keeping myself busy with different things. I'm trying to learn fashion from Serge Ibaka.”

Marc Gasol on Serge Ibaka, Jul 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Pascal Siakam on Toronto's two-headed monster at C of Ibaka and Gasol:

“Obviously Serge has been playing unbelievable the whole time with all the injuries. He’s been great. Having those two guys coming in and out is a nightmare for the other team,”

Pascal Siakam on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Jan 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Kevin Durant on why he chose Nets over Knicks in conversation with Serge Ibaka:

“I just like the organization as far as just the direction they were going in.. it was nothing major against the Knicks. I just think Brooklyn is farther along in the process of being a contender.”

Kevin Durant on Serge Ibaka, Oct 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Nurse:

“Listen, I couldn't be more proud of Serge Ibaka. Marc gets his 4th (foul) and Serge had a bad stint in the 1st half. And we really needed him to step up and play, and he played him butt off, man. God, he played great.”

Nick Nurse on Serge Ibaka, Apr 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Nick Nurse on when he'll make a call on Ibaka or Gasol as the starting C:

“Soon. I’m looking at it. I will continue to evaluate the units playing together.”

Nick Nurse on Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Mar 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Casey on Ibaka:

“Like baseball hitters, some people go through ruts, and our job as a coaching staff and as a team is to help him out of it, not bury him or put dirt on him.”

Dwane Casey on Serge Ibaka, May 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Brooks on his former player, Serge Ibaka:

“He's a terrific, if not one of the best jump shooting bigs in the league. If he gets shots he's going to score on you.”

Scott Brooks on Serge Ibaka, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Casey on Ibaka:

“It's a huge help, don't get me wrong, but he's not alone the saviour,it's everybody collectively pulling together”

Dwane Casey on Serge Ibaka, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Ujiri on trying to re-sign Ibaka this summer:

“I think it's extremely important. It's really important that we're able to do that”

Masai Ujiri on Serge Ibaka, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Royce Young:Westbrook on playing against Ibaka:

“For me, it's normal. When I get on the floor I have no friends. Off the floor I'll talk to him.”

Russell Westbrook on Serge Ibaka, Nov 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Serge Ibaka, Ersan Ilyasova, Victor Oladipo
item.description:
“Serge (Ibaka) is a young veteran who brings tremendous athleticism and toughness to our frontcourt. His tireless work ethic and wealth of playoff experience will help enhance our culture and roster. We thank Victor (Oladipo) for all of his contributions both on the court and in the community. We wish him and Ersan (Ilyasova) the best of luck in the future,”

Rob Hennigan on Serge Ibaka, Ersan Ilyasova, Victor Oladipo, Jun 24, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Fran Fraschilla on Pau Gasol, Ricky Rubio, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka
item.description:
international basketball expert and ESPN analyst Fran Fraschilla told me.

“This team rode the back of a 35-year-old player who in Pau Gasol still has great heart and very good ability. But this is not the same team that challenged the USA for a period of three or four years. I don’t think they will go into 2016 – even though Marc Gasol and Ricky Rubio will be back and potentially Serge Ibaka – as the same threat they were for a period of about four years. But they are the most likely team to knock off the USA in Brazil.”

Fran Fraschilla on Pau Gasol, Ricky Rubio, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Sep 24, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Sam Presti on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Royce Young:Presti on Ibaka:

“I think Serge may have had the best summer of any of our players, just in terms of improvement and overall development.”

Sam Presti on Serge Ibaka, Sep 23, 2015. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Dan McCarney:Ginobili on Ibaka injury:

“It's quite a loss for them. Hopefully we use that to our advantage.”

Manu Ginobili on Serge Ibaka, May 17, 2014. Source: Twitter @danmccarneysaen.

item.title: Nikola Mirotic on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Mirotic, who has a passport from Montenegro and Spain, missed Eurobasket 2013, but now he intends to play FIBA World Cup in Spain next summer.

“I want to play for Spain. I don’t want that people have doubt about me. I hope that Spanish federation will publicly say if they want Serge Ibaka or me to play”

Nikola Mirotic on Serge Ibaka, Mar 17, 2014. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Nikola Mirotic on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Mirotic:

“I want to play with Spain. What I want is that there's no room for doubt. I hope the Spanish Basketball Federation decides if they want me or Serge Ibaka to play with them.”

Nikola Mirotic on Serge Ibaka, Mar 15, 2014. Source: Twitter @pilarcasado.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Matt Barnes:

“I have gotten into altercations with other guys that I'm friends with or that I'm cool with, and after the game we either shake hands or a phone call would take place. But I don't like Serge Ibaka, so I wouldn't apologize to him. That's just someone I don't like. But I own up to what I tweeted, and it wasn't right. It was in the heat of the moment, and I really didn't think things fully through. As soon as I sent it, once I started driving home, I'm like, 'That's probably not going to be too good.'”

Matt Barnes on Serge Ibaka, Nov 15, 2013. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Blake Griffin, Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Griffin got position on Ibaka, who dropped his hand into the front of Griffin's shorts to drop the All-Star.

“I didn't see it to where it was like that flagrant. (Griffin) took (Ibaka's) arm and knocked him down. The dude (is) known for flopping anyway, so that's what it is,”

Kendrick Perkins on Blake Griffin, Serge Ibaka, Mar 4, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
That message has since been deleted, and Jackson posted an apology for his comments on Sunday.

“I apologize to Serge Ibaka, the NBA, and to all my fans for the comments I made,”

Stephen Jackson on Serge Ibaka, Dec 9, 2012. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Serge Ibaka:

“I’m happy for him. He deserves every penny. He worked his way up. He was unknown coming into the league. A lot of people didn’t really know what he could do on the court. He showed everybody from Day One that he could play and I’m just excited he’s here in Oklahoma City for four more years.”

Kevin Durant on Serge Ibaka, Aug 20, 2012. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Royce Young:Scott Brooks on Ibaka's hands:

“It's not like he's Fred Biletnikoff or anything, but he doesn't have bad hands either.”

Scott Brooks on Serge Ibaka, Jun 23, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kaleb Canales on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Kaleb Canales on where Serge Ibaka ranks league-wide in terms of defensive impact on a game:

“Top 5, top 10. He's top tier for sure. His ability to block shots, even though he doesn't get to some, him and [Kendrick] Perkins defensively as a tandem are one of the best.”

Kaleb Canales on Serge Ibaka, Mar 28, 2012. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Jamal Crawford on Serge Ibaka
item.description:
Chris Haynes:Jamal Crawford on incident w/S. Ibaka:

“I don't know what he said, but his expression was enough. I've never backed down from a challenge.”

Jamal Crawford on Serge Ibaka, Mar 19, 2012. Source: Twitter.
